'''Mortris Gallorr''' was a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who lived in the town of [[Corestrike]] on [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. Gallorr settled on Chrona before the planet experienced a boom with the discovery of [[chronamite]] to start a family and indulge his love of fixing machines. Gallorr established a [[Gallorr's Light Repair Shed|shop]] and gained a reputation as the best mechanic for fixing small vehicles and farming machinery. After the death of his wife, Gallorr turned the majority of the business over to his son, [[Arno Gallorr|Arno]] and his wife [[Serise Gallorr|Serise]].<ref name="HNNA" />

Gallorr was caught off-guard when the discovery of chronamite caused the town of Corestrike to grow up around his shop. As the town grew and people moved in, crime followed. Gallorr was a member of the [[Magistrate Council]], and wanted to return peace and law to the town. To that end, he organized a fund to hire [[Police officer/Legends|Protectors]] to act as independent [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]].<ref name="HNNA" />
